title: Largest Contentful Paint by browser family
sqlTemplate: select user_agent_user_agent_family as browser, approx_percentile_cont(view_largest_contentful_paint, 0.75) as p75, count(*) filter (where view_largest_contentful_paint is not null) as sample_count from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}} and type = 'view' group by user_agent_user_agent_family order by p75 desc limit 20
emptyDataSemantics: No matching view records -> an empty result set (zero rows); a present row's p75 is only NULL if that browser group's sample_count is 0, which cannot happen since the GROUP BY only ever produces rows for browsers that had at least one matching view.
